prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic red-carpet fashion portrait of a generic adult woman with light hazel eyes, fair natural skin, dusty-rose lipstick, neutral eye shadow, structured brows and long voluminous deep-chestnut Hollywood waves in a deep side part. She looks back over her shoulder with quiet confidence while wearing an opaque jet-black column evening gown with intricate sequin embellishment, shimmering lace texture, refined straps and a tasteful open-back design. Include blurred photographers, warm event drapery, red carpet and soft press lighting. Preserve elegant fashion intent without reproducing Ana de Armas or any other public-figure likeness.
